answer: Trust is accumulated from verified, reciprocal service and propagated through the EigenTrust matrix with reciprocity-weighted transitivity; its weight decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so influence requires sustained honest behavior. A newly spawned Sybil node has almost no trusted incoming mass and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality. Splitting activity among cedar, quill, and tide aliases does not create trust, leaving them below the consensus threshold.
